source_manifest.title: The ABO blood group
source_manifest.population: Established reference biology; no participant testing
source_manifest.passage: ABO antigens are surface carbohydrates. A and B glycosyltransferases modify the H precursor differently; typical group O lacks A and B modifications. ABO phenotype does not uniquely identify an individual genotype.
limitations: Reference biology is not a malaria effect estimate.
Rare and weak phenotypes require separate characterization.

source_manifest.title: The Rh blood group
source_manifest.population: Established reference biology; no participant testing
source_manifest.location: Antigens of the Rh blood group / Molecular information, Protein
source_manifest.passage: RhD is a transmembrane protein bearing the D antigen. Rh is a separate protein antigen system from ABO carbohydrates. Reported RhD status does not resolve a participant RHD sequence or genotype.
limitations: This chapter does not establish a RhD-specific malaria association.
RhD variants and typing complexities are outside this schematic.

source_manifest.title: Blood group O protects against severe Plasmodium falciparum malaria through the mechanism of reduced rosetting
source_manifest.design: Matched case-control study and parasite rosetting assays
source_manifest.population: Malian children; severe cases compared with uncomplicated malaria and healthy controls
source_manifest.endpoint: Severe P. falciparum malaria and rosetting
source_manifest.passage: In Malian children, group O was associated with lower odds of severe falciparum malaria compared with pooled non-O groups. Parasite rosetting observations supported a possible mechanistic link. The pooled comparison is not an O-versus-B-specific effect estimate, and severity is not infection susceptibility.
limitations: Observational association is not proof of causality or individual protection.
Pooled non-O findings cannot be converted to a pairwise B effect.
Rosetting is adhesion between infected and uninfected erythrocytes, not parasite invasion.
source_manifest.passage_kind: curator paraphrase of inspected source, not a verbatim quotation

source_manifest.title: Non-O ABO blood group genotypes differ in their associations with Plasmodium falciparum rosetting and severe malaria
source_manifest.design: Case-control study and in vitro adhesion assays
source_manifest.population: Kenyan children and donor erythrocytes in laboratory rosetting assays
source_manifest.endpoint: Severe malaria by ABO genotype and rosette size
source_manifest.passage: A Kenyan study examined specific ABO genotypes rather than assuming all non-O groups were equivalent. In assays using A-preferring parasites, rosettes involving AO and BO cells were indistinguishable from OO, whereas AA and AB formed larger rosettes. Most genotype contrasts lacked statistical significance; low-frequency genotypes limited power.
limitations: Parasite preference and laboratory conditions constrain generalization.
Reported B phenotype does not identify BO or BB genotype.
Neither genotype associations nor in vitro rosettes predict an individual outcome.
These findings qualify a simple O-versus-all-non-O schematic.
source_manifest.passage_kind: curator paraphrase of inspected source, not a verbatim quotation

source_manifest.title: Association of ABO blood group with severe falciparum malaria in adults: case control study and meta-analysis
source_manifest.population: Adults in Odisha, India; severe and uncomplicated falciparum malaria groups
source_manifest.passage: An adult Indian case-control study reported an association of group B with severe falciparum malaria. The authors contrasted this with reports emphasizing A or AB in other populations and discussed differences in populations and infective strains. Its population-specific finding does not establish a universal B-versus-O effect.
limitations: Geography, age, study design and parasite populations affect applicability.
Observational associations are not personal risk estimates.
No RhD-specific malaria distinction is established by this source.
source_manifest.passage_kind: curator paraphrase of inspected source, not a verbatim quotation
